description.en: The sale mode. This parameter is deprecated.

description.zh:
<props="china">重置是否保留属性设置，不传则默认不保留属性配置，该参数仅针对云手机矩阵实例生效。可执行wya dump config命令查看保留的属性详情。</props>
<props="intl">国际站不支持此参数</props>
description.en: <props="china">Specifies whether to retain the property settings when you reset the instances. By default, the property settings are not retained. This parameter applies only to cloud phone matrix instances. Run the wya dump config command to view the details of the retained properties.</props><props="intl">This parameter is not supported on the international site (alibabacloud.com).</props>

descriptions.zh: 只有实例处于**可用、已关机、异常、备份失败、恢复失败**状态时才支持重置（初始化系统）。
descriptions.en: You can reset an instance (initialize its system) only when the instance is Active, Stopped, Abnormal, Backup Failed, or **Recover Failed**.
